key_terms: An ordered, append-only Kafka log within a topic. Offsets identify positions only inside one partition, so a topic has no global order across partitions.
The sequential position of a record within one partition. A consumer reads by offset without removing the record from the log.
The optional part of a record that the producer's partitioner commonly uses to send related events to the same partition.
A set of consumers that share a topic's partitions and store their progress under one group identifier, independently of other groups that replay the same topic.
Kafka's built-in metadata quorum mode, used here as one combined broker and controller process with replication factor one.
evidence: Actual owned Docker workshop observations, with source, failure and lifecycle scope stated separately. Commands are not executed by the classroom pad.
